reviews.summary: No current, directly relevant ADA security incident, chain outage, material supply event, or confirmed venue action was identified. Venue is unspecified, so exchange-specific maintenance or listing status could not be verified.

facts.fact: Cardano Foundation announced Fireblocks support for Cardano Native Tokens on September 24, 2026; this is an ecosystem integration announcement, not an adverse protocol event. ([cardanofoundation.org](https://cardanofoundation.org/blog/fireblocks-cardano-native-tokens?utm_source=openai))

Official Cardano materials list TOKEN2049 ecosystem events for October 6–8, 2026; these are scheduled promotional/developer events, not a protocol migration or supply event. ([token2049.cardano.org](https://token2049.cardano.org/?utm_source=openai))

The Cardano node repository shows active maintenance through October 3, 2026; the reviewed sources did not disclose a current published security advisory or mainnet outage. ([github.com](https://github.com/IntersectMBO/cardano-node/?utm_source=openai))
